answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity like a pearl diver prices a find: each agent sinks a refundable bond into a shared river of verified work, and only steady useful output over many epochs lets it surface. A raven copying another bird's call still has no nest of its own -- fresh keys start with zero history, so a thousand fakes must each pay the full bond and the full waiting time, while one honest agent reuses its earned standing again and again.
